tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Window background. Everything sits directly on it; no card layer.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised layers only: dialogs, popovers, menus, the compact widget body.

tokens.name: dial-face
tokens.usage: Face of the interactive clock and mini clocks.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inputs, hover fill on rows and buttons, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and regions (1px). Decorative only.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control (inputs, toggles, minute ticks). ≥3:1 on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and clock hands on ground, surface, field and dial-face.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: country, dates, offsets. On ground, surface, field.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: captions, numerals on the dial, hints. ≥4.5:1 on ground and dial-face.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Signal orange. The selected-time hand, the timeline cursor, the primary action. Use once per view region.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for the selected row, overlap window and active segment.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. ≥3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: work
tokens.usage: Working-hours marks and the ‘good overlap’ status text on ground/surface.

tokens.name: work-band
tokens.usage: Working-hours fill in timeline cells and row day strips.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: ‘Partial’ status text and just-outside-working-hours marks.

tokens.name: edge-band
tokens.usage: Fill for the hour either side of working hours.

tokens.name: off-band
tokens.usage: Awake but off-hours fill (evenings, weekends).

tokens.name: sleep
tokens.usage: Sleeping-hours marks and the ‘poor overlap’ status text.

tokens.name: sleep-band
tokens.usage: Sleeping-hours fill.

tokens.name: sky-day
tokens.usage: Daylight segments of the dial's outer sky ring.

tokens.name: sky-twilight
tokens.usage: Civil-twilight segments of the sky ring (sun 0° to −6°).

tokens.name: sky-night
tokens.usage: Night segments of the sky ring.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Validation errors (time input, search). Always paired with a message.

tokens.name: win-close
tokens.usage: Windows close-button hover fill (system value). White glyph on it.

families.sans: "Geist", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Selected time under the dial. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: row-time
styles.usage: Local time in comparison rows and the compact widget.

styles.name: dial-numeral
styles.usage: Hour numerals inside the SVG dial (viewBox units, scales with the dial).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: AM/PM marks and timeline hour labels. Uppercase only for AM/PM.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control padding, gaps inside a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding, button padding-x.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Region padding, gap between dial and readout.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between the three main regions.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Onboarding and empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, timeline cells, kbd.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, rows on hover, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, compact widget window.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dialogs. The only elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Prototype window frame and the floating widget (the OS draws the real one).

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, focus.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Popovers, row insert/remove, date-window flip.

tokens.name: dur-hand
tokens.usage: Clock hands settling after a jump (spring-like ease). 0 when reduced motion.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for entering elements.

tokens.name: ease-hand
tokens.usage: Clock hands: a small overshoot, like a sprung movement.
